items: SQL Injection — try ', " , ' OR '1'='1, error-based / blind / union
XSS — <script>alert(1)</script> in inputs, look for reflected output
IDOR — change user IDs in URL: /account/123 → /account/124
Auth bypass — JWT none algorithm, session token reuse, logic flaws
SSRF — make the server fetch URLs you choose: http://target/?url=file:///etc/passwd
